_notes.why: The inline-SVG fallback is the LAST link in the header logo chain. If it fires terminal=true the header is showing a broken/empty image to real users — nothing further will save it, so alert immediately.
_notes.fingerprint: Events are grouped in the SDK by ['header.logo.error', stage, fallback_chain, correlationId] — see fingerprint block in src/lib/sentry-forwarder.server.ts. That means one Sentry issue per (stage, chain, page load); this rule notifies once per NEW issue and again if a resolved one reappears, so terminal SVG failures never sit unseen.
_notes.actionMatch: all conditions must fire — first-seen OR reappeared triggers, both filters must match (logger + stage + terminal).
_notes.frequency_minutes: Sentry re-notifies at most every 5 minutes per issue to avoid pager fatigue during a broad outage; the fingerprint already dedupes bursts.
_notes.install: POST this JSON to /api/0/projects/{org}/{project}/rules/ or paste via Alerts → Create Alert → Issue Alert → View as JSON.
